san-bernardino-spl-gen-long-alpine-day.title: San Bernardino · Splügen Long Alpine Day
san-bernardino-spl-gen-long-alpine-day.slogan: Big southern light, old pass mood and a serious return.
san-bernardino-spl-gen-long-alpine-day.story: Big southern light, old pass mood and a serious return. Out of Chur and back again: 322 km, roughly 6 h 12 in the saddle. It goes by way of Mesocco and Thusis. The climbs: San Bernardino pass road and Splügenpass hairpins. It tops out at 2,114 m. San Bernardino Pass and Splugen Pass are open in summer only - check it is open before you set off. The passes are the reason to go.
san-bernardino-spl-gen-long-alpine-day.hero: San Bernardino Pass Splügen Pass road

waypoints.name: San Bernardino pass road
waypoints.advice: You top out at 2066 m here. The road climbs 1473 m on the way up to it, steadily. Reckon on about 10 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. At this height the road is a summer one: snow gates can stay shut into June and shut again in October. Next is Mesocco, mostly downhill.

scenicChapters.title: Passo dello Spluga
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 133 km. 1473 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall. A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Passo dello Spluga
scenicChapters.narrative: Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it. The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2066 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: For 51 km this is Grand Tour of Switzerland, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Stadhuis → Belfort met Lakenhal
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 26 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

It crosses from Belgium into France - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules.
